name: video-generation-plugin
description: Adds AI video generation to chat and agent workflows via Runway ML (baseline), with OpenAI Sora and Kling AI registered behind credential gates. Registers the generate_video tool callable from LLC agent tasks. Generation is async (submit then poll).
author: mrveiss

default_provider.description: Default provider used when none is specified in the tool call

required_env.name: RUNWAY_API_KEY
required_env.description: Runway ML API key for video generation (Gen-3/Gen-4 via the developer API)
obtain_steps: Create a developer account and generate an API key
Set RUNWAY_API_KEY to the generated key

required_env.name: SORA_API_KEY
required_env.description: OpenAI Sora API key for video generation (credential-gated; enabled when the key is set)
obtain_steps: Create an API key with Sora video access
Set SORA_API_KEY to the generated key

required_env.name: KLING_API_KEY
required_env.description: Kling AI API key for video generation (credential-gated; enabled when the key is set)
obtain_steps: Go to https://klingai.com and obtain API access
Set KLING_API_KEY to the generated key
